brief.aim: The table is a physicochemical profile of wines with a single graded sensory score, quality, observed as seven discrete ordered grades (3-9) and heavily concentrated at 5-7; per RL-0002 three or more discrete labels make this a multiclass study predicting quality from the chemistry features, leaving the workflow metric in place. No column is a row key, a recoding of quality, or known only after tasting, so no identifier or leakage suspects are listed.
brief.repeated_subjects: No column identifies a repeated wine, batch or producer; each row is treated as an independent sample.
